verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents AskFred, an in-product AI assistant that answers natural-language questions about the user's meetings. It also runs multi-meeting analysis to find patterns and aggregate insights, and it generates summaries, notes and action items automatically after every meeting. That covers both the insights and the actionable-suggestions parts of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-product next-step suggestions (only documented for Slack), not just action items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AskFred is Fireflies' AI-powered meeting assistant that lets you ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts.
**Multi-Meeting Analysis** - Query across meetings using filters to identify patterns and aggregate insights
Query individual meetings or search across multiple meetings to get intelligent, context-aware answers.
Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
Fred records, transcribes, & summarizes meetings with notes, decisions, & action items.
